_comment: Who at Black Raven IT cares about what, so a bot posting in #watercooler can pull
the right person into a topic they actually like (Brian, 2026-10-21: 'when Jacob
EVERY entry here is evidence, not a guess. These were read off the people's own
#watercooler messages in the Nexus D1 (William on 4Runners and Land Cruisers, Edgar
on his tile work, Joseph on Chicago storms and the train, and so on). A bot naming a
real coworker is a claim about that coworker, so an invented interest is a
fabrication with their name attached. Add a line only when you have actually seen
'handle' is what goes in the message. Nexus resolves a mention against the display
name, the UPN local part, the FIRST WORD of the display name, and any alias, so a
bare first name works and notifies. 'match' holds the words in a post that should
pull this person in; keep them specific, since a loose word like 'car' drags someone
